summary: Implement immutable tenant-scoped provenance linked to exact audit/outbox evidence, instrument canonical Price and Inventory mutations, and add a bounded authenticated-scope lineage timeline read API.

impacts.evidence: Lineage records and inputs are organization/workspace scoped, protected by composite workspace foreign keys, transaction-local scope and forced RLS. The database also verifies that linked audit/outbox evidence belongs to the same tenant.

Lineage stores bounded identifiers, versions, mapping/rule ids and timestamps only. It does not copy price/stock payloads, arbitrary metadata blobs or credentials; future retention must treat lineage as auditable provenance.

An additive GET /lineage/timeline OpenAPI operation and two Draft 2020-12 lineage schemas are introduced. Existing operations and response fields are unchanged; the reusable handler requires an authenticated scope resolver.

Existing pricing/inventory event schemas and event ids are unchanged. Each lineage record references the exact existing outbox event committed by the domain mutation rather than publishing a parallel incompatible event.

Connector SDK v1 root interfaces, sandbox, plugin-security and conformance contracts are unchanged. Future connectors may supply mapping/rule lineage metadata through host integration without importing lineage persistence directly.
Expand migration 000014 adds lineage_records and lineage_inputs with indexes, forced RLS and append-only/evidence guards. No existing table or column is dropped or renamed.

Lineage write/read scope is tenant-bound. PostgreSQL rejects cross-tenant audit/outbox references, UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE are blocked, and the API does not accept organization/workspace ids from caller-controlled query/header data.

Task 017 approval remains the authorization boundary. Task 030 adds post-decision provenance links that can reference the same correlation/causation chain; it cannot approve or bypass a sensitive write.
Task 030 becomes the canonical lineage contract: output version/field, ordered inputs, transformation identity/version and exact audit/event evidence are immutable and queryable as a timeline.

Lineage ids are deterministically derived from the immutable event id, so retry of the same domain mutation is idempotent while an id collision with different immutable metadata fails closed. Correlation/causation remain available for later reconciliation.
Task 030 performs no outbound webhook or network egress. The timeline is a read-only internal API surface; Task 063 continues to own durable outbound webhooks.
Bounded indexed timeline queries expose mutation provenance and stable correlation ids for support/observability without log scraping. Pagination is capped at 200 records.

The migration is additive and binary rollback leaves lineage evidence intact. Lineage tables must not be dropped during rollback because they preserve historical provenance linked to audit/outbox evidence.

Tests cover record/cursor validation, deterministic ids, secure API scope resolution, migration RLS/immutability/evidence guards, and static proof that Price/Inventory mutations append lineage without copying business payloads or secrets.
